question: Is every tool the NPC set needs captured, and what must change when it is recreated?
answer: Yes — 12 managed tools plus 3 inline tools. The 12 were captured as standalone files; the 3 inline ones live inside the squad and workflow payloads and had NOT been called out as tools needing migration until this audit.
method: Every NPC assistant, squad, workflow and phone number was walked recursively. Two passes: (a) every UUID in every string, matched against the /tool list — this proves no managed tool is reachable by a path other than model.toolIds; (b) every object under ANY key containing 'tool', which is what caught 'tools:append' — a key a plain 'tools' check misses.

inlineTools.why: This is the routing brain of the inbound squad — it is how the receptionist hands a caller to the right booking agent. It is not in /tool and not in any toolIds array.

destinationsByAssistantId.name: NPC Opt In Follow Up Inbound

inlineTools.cloneAction: Recreate with the squad, and REMAP all three assistantIds to the new account's ids. Left unremapped they point at the old org and the handoff silently fails.

inlineTools.defect: destinations is an EMPTY array — the transfer node cannot transfer to anything
inlineTools.cloneAction: Carried across as-is. Decide whether to configure a destination or delete the node.

inlineTools.defect: its spoken message is "Thank you for calling Wellness Partners. Have a wonderful day!" — a leftover from the template this workflow was built from, not an NPC line
inlineTools.cloneAction: Carried across as-is. Fix the wording before this workflow is used.

danglingToolReferences.note: Referenced by assistants but GET /tool/{id} returns 404 — deleted from the org while the assistants kept pointing at them. Nothing to capture; recorded so a clone does not treat the gap as an export failure.
